Subject: POC blocked by vendor API change — request for short extension + credits

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our engineering lead: a surprise change in a downstream payments vendor’s API has blocked our connector tests. We were on track to finish the Cardinal POC this week but need time to patch the adapter and re-run QA.

Ask: would Redwood be able to (1) extend our sandbox window by two weeks and (2) provision an additional 30k token sandbox credit to cover re-runs and validation?

We can provide logs and a short walk-through with our engs tomorrow morning. Attaching a small error sample to show the failing request.

This POC is time-boxed on our side; we want to avoid having to restart the provisioning cycle if possible. Appreciate any flexibility you can offer.

Thanks,
Alyssa Gomez
Director, Platform Integrations
Cardinal HealthTech

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the error sample, that helps. Sorry to hear about the vendor churn. We definitely want to keep momentum on the POC. Two quick notes:

- We can usually grant a one-week sandbox extension quickly; two weeks + extra credit requires a short approval from Sales Ops given the size.
- If you can do a 30-minute troubleshooting call with your eng tomorrow at 10am PT, Priyom can triage whether the issue is on your side or a connector mismatch we can patch on our end.

Ben / Priyom — will you weigh in on the extra 30k credit? I included a conservative estimate of token usage (we’d prefer to issue a promo credit rather than move to paid usage mid-POC). If feasible, please advise next steps and required approvals.

Alyssa, if you confirm the 10am slot I’ll schedule and loop Engineering.

Best,
Marissa Cole
